describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): define embedded codecs and exact authored map ownership (#838)

kind: Reviewed case data; no executable tests/validator/gates added

E01.proves: Current identical source/syntax inputs share keys; changed bytes/options/dialect do not.
E01.limit: No native formatter/profile/config cache exists; these do not prove FD02/FD18 service identity.

E02.proves: Current typed diagnostic ordering discriminates its key dimensions and ignores discovery order.
E02.limit: No proof of future Doc/edit/map ordering.

E03.proves: Existing TypeInfo request/envelope payload survives serialization; supported empty and unsupported remain distinct.
E03.limit: No native FormatRequest/FormatResult or formatter parity is shipped.

E04.proves: Current LineIndex ASCII round-trip and supplementary/UTF-8 positions at valid boundaries.
E04.limit: Not strict formatter UTF-16 surrogate-split rejection, formatted cursor conversion or all UTF-32/CRLF cases.

E05.proves: Current registered snapshots preserve jointly validated basis and reject obsolete/tampered content.
E05.limit: No formatter publication/admission path exists yet.

E06.proves: Existing whitespace-only route and its limited behavior, not native formatting.
E06.limit: Superseded route-only tests retire with FMT3; they do not establish full formatting, edit non-overlap or idempotence.

cases.name: One outer and one embedded ownership path
cases.input: Vue/Svelte carrier with ordered script, style and template regions; catalog registration order reversed
cases.required: Unique outer selection and unique exact-language embedded contributions; identical output/provenance order; reject missing or duplicate claims
cases.forbidden: Framework-name branch, first-registered choice, duplicate embedded formatting or private renderer
cases.executionScope: UAP0 subblock 3 architecture fixture; implementation remains with inventory owner

cases.name: Truthful option outcomes
cases.input: Captured format section containing unknown name, wrong type, inapplicable known option and known unsupported value, with a supported absent default control
cases.required: Four truthful diagnostics as classified by the locked policy; admitted missing option alone gets its provenanced default
cases.forbidden: Silently ignore/coerce/drop explicit values or report successful empty edits
cases.executionScope: UAP0 subblock 3 architecture fixture; implementation remains with inventory owner

cases.name: Separate formatting and action map authority
cases.input: Same carrier receives one formatter edit and one lint/action fix against different source revisions
cases.required: Formatter map and action transaction remain distinct; stale action is refused by action owner, not blessed by formatter correspondence
cases.forbidden: Reuse formatter map as action validity or invoke lint fixer during formatting
cases.executionScope: UAP0 subblock 3 architecture fixture; implementation remains with inventory owner

cases.name: Inventory omission and owner conflict
cases.input: Reviewed inventory with one removed consumer, nonexistent owner, pathless owner or two deletion assignments
cases.required: Validator rejects each independently and accepts the original complete inventory
cases.forbidden: Accept plausible owner text without a real successor/receiving contract
cases.executionScope: UAP0 subblock 3 architecture fixture; implementation remains with inventory owner

cases.name: Exact versus default versus unsupported
cases.input: Same hermetic input with three locked cells: exact Prettier bytes, pre-ratified native divergence, literal unsupported reason
cases.required: Exact byte comparison for exact cell; locked native bytes for default; typed refusal before printing for unsupported
cases.forbidden: Whitespace-normalized parity, post-hoc divergence, exact-to-default fallback
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Config provenance and trusted capture
cases.input: Parent config, ignore rule and matching override plus a captured executable-config snapshot; prepared-input host missing one required capture
cases.required: FCFG0 normalizes once with ordered contributing provenance; missing capture stays NeedInputs; ignored file is explicit skipped/inapplicable
cases.forbidden: Runtime config execution, private option defaults in printer, forged Complete unchanged result
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Private domain and provenance discrimination
cases.input: Authored/formatted ranges over astral Unicode, CRLF and EOF; duplicate conflicting ID, unknown rendered ID, cross-revision ID
cases.required: Foundation rejects mixed/invalid domains and bindings; deterministic same-revision table reconstruction
cases.forbidden: Bare integer or generated-TSX conversion, two independently declared provenance tokens
cases.receivingAcceptance: Table-driven identity tests reject duplicate/mismatched authored bindings, unknown IDs, and cross-revision reuse while preserving deterministic same-revision reconstruction.
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Lossless authored coverage and recovery
cases.input: BOM, comments, raw script/style literals, custom block and malformed delimiter island in one carrier
cases.required: Every source/trivia region accounted for once in source order; exact island bytes or typed refusal; reuse existing parse
cases.forbidden: Lossy semantic-AST reconstruction, regex recovery, second parser, format-on-parse
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Doc rendering determinism and group laws
cases.input: Shared Doc with nested groups, hard/soft lines, Unicode text, tabs, conditional breaks and multiple suffixes
cases.required: Locked width/newline/suffix policy yields deterministic bytes and ordered source-backed segments
cases.forbidden: Semantic parse/resolve, unordered suffix flush, recovery text whitespace normalization
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Exact edit application and minimality
cases.input: Source/result pair with two changed interior islands, stable middle, Unicode, CRLF, EOF and adjacent insertion
cases.required: Sorted non-overlapping scalar-boundary edits apply exactly; stable regions remain; no no-op edit
cases.forbidden: Whole-file replacement when smaller set proven or unbounded quadratic diff
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Retained and changed position mapping
cases.input: Known retained token IDs plus inserted/deleted/replaced segments at scalar/CRLF/EOF boundaries
cases.required: Round-trip retained positions under locked bias; changed geometry explicit; ambiguity/absence typed
cases.forbidden: Proportional interpolation, duplicate unknown IDs, wrong output/source basis
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Embedded reversible map eligibility
cases.input: Cooked escape, indentation removal and interpolation hole with composed codec stages; one mismatched stage revision
cases.required: Exact endpoint joins and unique editable preimage; missing/non-reversible geometry refuses or retains under explicit cell policy
cases.forbidden: Private decoder/composer, hole crossing guessed span, clamp, raw fallback from cooked
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Outer and child boundary ownership
cases.input: Inline script/style plus raw recovery and an external src resource
cases.required: Outer owns delimiters/trivia; each child only its declared extent; external source unchanged or explicit unsupported
cases.forbidden: Child steals sibling trivia or edits external source as current carrier bytes
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Safe range and unaffected control
cases.input: Selection inside token, hole, raw text or malformed island, with stable siblings on both sides
cases.required: Smallest locked safe expansion or truthful refusal; outside bytes unchanged; expanded range agrees with full slice
cases.forbidden: Split island/delimiters, edit unrelated sibling or force full-file fallback
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Cursor affinity and correct output basis
cases.input: Cursors before/inside/after retained, inserted, replaced and deleted regions, astral scalar, CRLF and EOF
cases.required: Locked affinity yields deterministic formatted-domain position or explicit absence at non-unique preimage
cases.forbidden: Semantic nearest-token guess or authored/output source swap
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Strict public UTF-16 conversion
cases.input: Valid supplementary scalar boundary control; cursor splits surrogate pair; range inverted/out of extent; result byte inside UTF-8 scalar
cases.required: FMT4F accepts exact controls, rejects invalid boundaries and uses input for requests/output for results
cases.forbidden: Clamp, byte-as-UTF16 shortcut, stale source or private coordinate serialization
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: LSP negotiated encoding
cases.input: Same full-document output/edits through UTF-8, UTF-16 and UTF-32 document LineIndex
cases.required: Applying LSP TextEdits reconstructs direct output exactly; wrong revision/text fails
cases.forbidden: Default UTF-16 assumption, 0:0 fallback or guessed position
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Surface capability truth and outcome parity
cases.input: Shared full-format corpus through Rust/LSP/NAPI/WASM/MCP, plus range/cursor requests per capability table; Complete unchanged and unsupported controls
cases.required: Shared cells agree; cursor only private/NAPI/WASM, range only Rust/NAPI/WASM/MCP; refusals never success
cases.forbidden: Private support advertises LSP range/cursor or MCP/Rust cursor
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Idempotence, semantic stability and unaffected languages
cases.input: Valid and admitted recovery corpora with fixed profiles/options; add TypeScript/JSX/SCSS/Less contribution
cases.required: Native output is a fixed point, second pass zero edits; significant bytes/semantics preserved; unaffected language fixtures byte-identical
cases.forbidden: Normalize comparison or ratify new divergence after failed comparison
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Fresh versus incremental and edit/revert
cases.input: Same final basis reached fresh and through edit/revert, changing source, carrier, config provenance, catalog row or policy independently
cases.required: Equivalent complete output/edits/map answers; observed changes invalidate; unobserved provider changes do not; stable unaffected region lineage
cases.forbidden: Content-only cache hit or config changes forcing second syntax parse
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Cancellation, stale completion and partial child
cases.input: Cancel before entry and during render; race a new source revision; required embedded child returns partial
cases.required: No stale/cancelled/partial publication or warm admission; retry same final basis equals fresh
cases.forbidden: Empty Complete result, old edit publication or partial outer success
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Bounded work, warm/churn and zero work
cases.input: Cold/exact-warm/changed-region/edit-revert/range-query requests, adversarial nesting and fixed churn manifest; disabled/unrequested/provider-transition controls
cases.required: FMT0-sized counts/growth and explicit stack/entry bounds; complete bytes emitted once; zero work for controls; closed sources retain no entries
cases.forbidden: Hidden parse/resolve/render/copy, unbounded group search, eager prewarm or ineligible cache entry
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only

cases.name: Atomic route switch and retained auto-close
cases.input: Existing LSP document formatting and > on-type fixtures before/after cutover
cases.required: Exactly one FMT4L→FMT4P→FMT3C document path; old whitespace body unreachable; continuously advertised document capability; auto-close unchanged; range absent
cases.forbidden: Dual route or on-type handler delegates to FormatterService
cases.executionScope: Future owning implementation proof; this file is reviewed data only
